trans-unit.source: WitnessRecord uses the camera to record video documentation of encounters. Video is captured only while you have started a recording.

trans-unit.target: L'accesso “Sempre” consente a WitnessRecord di continuare a registrare la posizione mentre lo schermo è nero o l'app è brevemente in background durante una registrazione, preservando il luogo in cui è stato catturato il filmato.

trans-unit.id: Create a Google account used only for WitnessRecord, and sign in to it here. Crucially, do not add that account to your iPhone's Settings, the Gmail or Drive apps, or any browser you're signed into. Then there is no way to open that Drive from your phone to delete anything — the account simply isn't reachable through the phone's apps. This app keeps its own private login and offers no way to view or delete the footage.
trans-unit.source: Create a Google account used only for WitnessRecord, and sign in to it here. Crucially, do not add that account to your iPhone's Settings, the Gmail or Drive apps, or any browser you're signed into. Then there is no way to open that Drive from your phone to delete anything — the account simply isn't reachable through the phone's apps. This app keeps its own private login and offers no way to view or delete the footage.
trans-unit.target: Crea un account Google usato solo per WitnessRecord e accedi da qui. È fondamentale non aggiungere quell'account alle Impostazioni del tuo iPhone, alle app Gmail o Drive, o a qualsiasi browser in cui hai eseguito l'accesso. In questo modo non c'è alcun modo di aprire quel Drive dal telefono per eliminare qualcosa — l'account semplicemente non è raggiungibile tramite le app del telefono. Questa app mantiene il proprio accesso privato e non offre alcun modo per visualizzare o eliminare i filmati.

trans-unit.id: Once every small chunk of a session is safely uploaded, WitnessRecord merges them into a single video per camera, uploads that to the session's Drive folder, and then deletes the small chunks — so you get one clean file per camera instead of a folder full of pieces. This never happens until the small chunks are already confirmed in Drive, so nothing is at risk while it runs. Turn this off to keep the individual chunks instead.
trans-unit.source: Once every small chunk of a session is safely uploaded, WitnessRecord merges them into a single video per camera, uploads that to the session's Drive folder, and then deletes the small chunks — so you get one clean file per camera instead of a folder full of pieces. This never happens until the small chunks are already confirmed in Drive, so nothing is at risk while it runs. Turn this off to keep the individual chunks instead.
trans-unit.target: Una volta che tutti i piccoli segmenti di una sessione sono stati caricati in sicurezza, WitnessRecord li unisce in un unico video per fotocamera, lo carica nella cartella Drive della sessione e poi elimina i segmenti — così ottieni un unico file pulito per fotocamera invece di una cartella piena di frammenti. Questo non avviene finché i segmenti non sono già confermati su Drive, quindi non c'è alcun rischio durante l'operazione. Disattiva questa opzione per mantenere invece i singoli segmenti.

trans-unit.id: Sharing with an emergency contact does not, by itself, give them a separate copy: it grants them a view of your file. If your copy is deleted, their view disappears with it (though deleted files sit in Drive's Trash, recoverable for ~30 days, unless the Trash is also emptied).

trans-unit.id: Your footage uploads to your own Google Drive. In Google Drive, the account owner can always delete their files. So if someone has your unlocked phone and can open the Google Drive app, the Gmail app, or drive.google.com in a browser, they can delete the recordings there — and deleting them removes access for your emergency contacts too.
trans-unit.source: Your footage uploads to your own Google Drive. In Google Drive, the account owner can always delete their files. So if someone has your unlocked phone and can open the Google Drive app, the Gmail app, or drive.google.com in a browser, they can delete the recordings there — and deleting them removes access for your emergency contacts too.
trans-unit.target: I tuoi filmati vengono caricati sul tuo Google Drive personale. Su Google Drive, il proprietario dell'account può sempre eliminare i propri file. Quindi, se qualcuno ha il tuo telefono sbloccato e può aprire l'app Google Drive, l'app Gmail o drive.google.com in un browser, può eliminare lì le registrazioni — ed eliminarle rimuove l'accesso anche ai tuoi contatti di emergenza.
